faq.a1: Yes, startups and established companies alike. We help you shape and ship an MVP or a full product, sized to your scope and budget.
faq.a2: Yes, from legacy PHP to a half-finished Angular migration. We audit it first, tell you honestly what we found, then get to work.
faq.a3: A scoped MVP usually takes 6–12 weeks from kick-off to production. After the two discovery sessions you know the real date, before you commit to anything.
faq.a4: Yes, before the first call if you need one. We treat everything you share with us as confidential either way.
faq.a5: Every fixed-scope project gets 30 days of free bug fixes, and we answer critical issues within 4 hours. After that we offer monthly support, sized to how much care the app needs, at a price we agree with you. You can change it at any time.
faq.a6: Yes, fully remote and async-first. We’re based in Prague and work with clients online, wherever they are.
faq.a7: It depends on the scope, so there’s no price list. Once we understand what you need, we agree the price with you, before we write any code. The first consultation with one of us is free.
